title: Flatten Nested List
description: Write a recursive function named flatten_nested_list that accepts an arbitrarily nested list of integers and returns a flat 1D list containing all the numbers in order. Empty sublists should simply contribute no elements.
hints: Arbitrarily nested structures require recursive traversal or an iterative stack to unwrap each nesting level.
Inspect how you distinguish list containers from leaf elements: use isinstance(item, list) to choose between recursion and appending.
Iterate through items: if isinstance(item, list), recursively extend the accumulator with flatten_nested_list(item); otherwise append the item.
